claims.text_ko: 순이익(net income) · quarter ended June 30, 2026: $14.5 million — 해당 분기 순이익은 전년 같은 분기보다 늘었다
claims.note_ko: 해당 분기 순이익은 전년 같은 분기보다 늘었다
claims.quote: Columbia Financial, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: CLBK), the holding company for Columbia Bank ("Columbia"), reported net income of $14.5 million, or $0.14 per basic and diluted share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, as compared to $12.3 million, or $0.12 per basic and diluted share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2025.
claims.subject: issuer

claims.text_ko: net interest income · quarter ended June 30, 2026: $9.2 million — 순이자 이익은 이자 수입 증가와 이자 비용 감소로 늘었다
claims.note_ko: 순이자 이익은 이자 수입 증가와 이자 비용 감소로 늘었다
claims.quote: The increase in net income was primarily attributable to a $9.2 million increase in net interest income and a $657,000 increase in non-interest income, partially offset by a $1.8 million increase in provision for credit losses, $4.5 million increase in non-interest expense, and a $1.3 million increase in income tax expense.
claims.subject: issuer

claims.text_ko: net interest margin · quarter ended June 30, 2026: 2.44% — 순이자 마진은 이자부 부채의 평균 비용 감소로 늘었다

claims.quote: The Company's net interest margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 increased 25 basis points to 2.44% when compared to 2.19%, for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, mostly due to a decrease in the average cost of interest-bearing liabilities.
claims.subject: issuer

claims.quote: Non-interest expense was $49.4 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, an increase of $4.5 million, or 10.0%, from $44.9 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2025.
